messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for inference-api v2.3.1 to cluster us-east-1-canary (10% traffic). Helm release: inference-api-20260315. Rollout id: ro-7f3a. Triggered by: pipeline #1234.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - 5xx spike detected for inference-api canary. 5xx rate 18% over baseline in the last 2m. Paging on-call. PD: PD-2456.

Maria: I'm oncall and looking. Any logs?

Kevin: grabbing logs from inference-api-canary-2... seeing KMS errors in the decrypt path.

Kevin: ```ERROR 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z inference-api KMSDecrypt failed key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999:key/abc123 error=AccessDeniedException
Trace: com.aws.kms.AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999:key/abc123```

Ellie: that arn looks like the rotated key. Did the deploy change the KMS key id?

deploy-bot: Release env shows KMS_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999:key/def456 (new key).

Kevin: weird — some pods have env var `KMS_KEY_ID` while others show `KMS_KEY`. Name mismatch.

Samir: checked k8s rollout history: canary pods on nodepool A are revision 5 (env KMS_KEY_ID), nodepool B on revision 4 (env KMS_KEY). Chart template conditional ended up rendering different env names depending on values. Looks like a template bug: `{{ default .Values.kms.key_id .Values.kms.key }}` produced inconsistent keys for older charts.

Maria: that would explain partial failures (only pods using new key are hitting permission issues). Immediate mitigation options: 1) stop canary traffic (kill switch), 2) patch older pods' env to include KMS_KEY_ID with the previous key, 3) roll back the release. Prefer 1 + 3 to minimize customer impact.

Ellie: flipping canary flag in router now.

Ellie: `> curl -X POST https://router.internal/flags/canary/inference-api -d 'enabled=false'` -> 200 OK

incident-bot: Canary traffic killed. Routing 100% -> stable. Monitoring error rate.

Kevin: initiating Helm rollback to stable revision 4: `helm rollback inference-api 4 --namespace prod`

Samir: rollback will reapply the stable templates (should unify env). Doing the rollback now.

deploy-bot: Helm rollback started. Expect pod restarts across the deployment.

ops-automation: watch: restart waves expected ~30s per pod, backoff scale may cause some delay.

Maria: customer impact estimate: ~14:22 to 14:34 UTC saw increased 5xx. Preliminary estimate ~0.4% of total requests affected, primarily EU region enterprise tenants. Support should prepare notifications.

Ellie: drafting support/status banner.

Ellie: `Draft: We experienced a brief deployment issue affecting inference requests between 14:22-14:34 UTC. Some requests returned errors. We have rolled back the canary and are monitoring. We'll follow up with affected customers.`

Maria: handing off primary to Kevin for post-rollback monitoring and incident writeup. I'll move this to follow-up doc and close PD. Kevin: you're primary for the next 2 hours.

Kevin: ack. Monitoring graphs show 5xx back to baseline at 14:36 UTC. No new alerts.

Samir: root cause summary: Helm/chart template condition allowed two different env var keys to appear across revisions (KMS_KEY vs KMS_KEY_ID). When the rotated key was introduced it changed permissions for the new arn; older pods continued using a different env name and therefore inconsistent behavior across the canary. Pre-deploy checks did not validate KMS decrypt in-canary.

Maria: action items (short):
- Revert the values change PR and block new deploys until fixed (owner: Samir).
- Add CI diff test to validate env var names parity across replicas (owner: Kevin).
- Add a canary smoke test that attempts a KMS decrypt using deployed env before shifting traffic; fail the rollout on decrypt error (owner: Kevin).
- Update runbook: verify KMS key propagation and configmap revision parity before enabling canary traffic (owner: Maria).
- Security: audit rotated key def456 permissions and rotation process (owner: security-team).

Kevin: opening INF-482 for CI/canary smoke test work.

Ellie: opening support ticket to notify affected customers and publish the banner.

ops-automation: recommendation: add a CD gating step that execs a small decrypt in the new pods, e.g. run `kubectl exec -it <pod> -- /bin/sh -c "python -c 'import boto3,os; boto3.client(\"kms\").decrypt(CiphertextBlob=b\"dummy\")'"` or use a mocked KMS test harness. Also add a check that env var names match expected keys across all replicas.

Maria: flagged to security-team for permission review. @security-team please confirm least-privilege role for def456 and that rotation process updates permissions atomically.

security-team: acknowledged. We'll audit the key policy and rotation runbook, will report back in the follow-up doc.

Maria: incident resolved at 14:40 UTC. Root cause, mitigation, and action items captured. PD incident closed. Follow-up doc and RCA to follow. Thanks all for fast response. :tada:
